body: Checked clean successor commit 9005320. The compact task map is now present and strong: model, represent recall, align, summarize, score interview, source inspection, embeddings, save/verify, and evidence/maturity are all linked from the front page. The capability bullets now cover proposition and embedding/feature work, but the other half of the breadth finding remains literal: no front-door mention of (1) PENMAN/AMR interop, (2) proposal/critic/resolution acquisition with typed outcomes, or (3) document mention graphs/coreference/narrative compilation. Please add those three existing capability families, in compact honest wording, before proposing the immutable candidate. I am deliberately not calling the explicit finding closed while named families remain absent.
